name: BOOM!Health Harm Reduction Center
description: South Bronx harm reduction center offering anonymous syringe access, naloxone, and health services, plus mobile vans and peer-delivered syringe exchange.
notes: Website lists 718.295.BOOM; NYS SSP directory (July 2026) lists 718-292-7718 x6474 for the program. NYS lists storefront hours Mon-Fri 9am-10pm, Sat 9am-3pm. NYC drug checking on 1st Thursdays.

name: Bronx Móvil
description: Mobile harm reduction and syringe service program in the Bronx.
notes: Listed in NYS SSP directory (July 2026), which points to the website for schedule; website failed TLS check in this session (certificate mismatch) so could not be confirmed directly. 2022 NYC guide noted mobile/weekend only.

name: St. Ann's Corner of Harm Reduction (SACHR)
description: Bronx harm reduction storefront offering syringe services, outreach, HIV prevention and a welcoming space for people who use drugs, at no cost.
notes: NYS SSP directory lists hours Mon-Fri 6am-12am (ground floor storefront).

name: The After Hours Project
description: Brooklyn-based harm reduction org offering syringe services, overdose prevention, mobile outreach, HIV testing, and housing help.
notes: NYS SSP directory lists Mon-Fri 9am-5pm at 1204 Broadway (Bed-Stuy) plus other Brooklyn sites.

name: Family Services Network of New York (FSNNY)
description: Brooklyn syringe service program with multiple sites in Bushwick and East New York, including 24/7 access at some locations.
notes: Confirmed in NYS SSP directory (July 2026); also lists 1721 Pitkin Ave (East New York). Website failed TLS check in this session; confirm before printing.

name: VOCAL-NY Harm Reduction Drop-In
description: Member-led advocacy org with a Brooklyn drop-in offering syringe exchange, overdose prevention, drug checking, and a 24/7 harm reduction vending machine.
notes: NYS directory: drop-in Mon-Fri 10:30am-5:30pm; 24/7 vending machine at 2640 Pitkin Ave, Brooklyn; van in Coney Island/Brighton Beach Thursdays. NYC drug checking Wednesdays.

name: Alliance for Positive Change – Lower East Side Harm Reduction Center
description: Lower East Side storefront harm reduction center offering syringe services, naloxone, HIV/HCV testing, and peer support.
notes: The Lower East Side Harm Reduction Center now operates as part of Alliance for Positive Change (listed as 'Alliance Lower East Side Harm Reduction Center' in NYS directory, July 2026). NYS hours: Mon 9am-7pm, Tue-Sat 9am-5pm. Alliance HQ is 64 W 35th St.

name: AIDS Center of Queens County (ACQC)
description: Queens HIV and harm reduction provider offering low-threshold syringe exchange, including a 24/7 vending machine in Far Rockaway.
notes: Website lists sites at 91-30 Van Wyck Expwy (Richmond Hill-Jamaica), 62-07 Woodside Ave, and 105-20 Rockaway Beach Blvd. NYS directory (July 2026) lists SSP main site as 147-23 Archer Ave, Jamaica (van, Mon & Thu 11am-3pm) with SSP phone 917-670-5687, and a 24/7 vending machine at 1600 Central Ave, Far Rockaway. Addresses differ between sources; confirm.

name: Community Health Action of Staten Island (CHASI) – Harm Reduction Hub
description: Staten Island's harm reduction hub offering syringe services, naloxone, and health and recovery support, with a 24/7 recovery center.
address: 166 Port Richmond Avenue, Staten Island, NY 10302
notes: Hub open Mon-Fri 9am-5pm. Next Step Resource & Recovery Center at 56 Bay St (1st fl) is listed by NYS as a 24/7 SSP site. The 2022 NYC guide phone (718-808-1815) differs from the current main number.

name: Harlem United – Syringe Services
description: One of NYC's first syringe exchanges, with a Harlem storefront and a Bronx van offering syringes, naloxone and drug checking.
address: 321 West 125th Street, 2nd Floor, New York, NY
notes: NYS hours: Mon-Fri 9:30am-3pm; Bronx van on Third Ave between E Tremont Ave & Cross-Bronx Expwy Mon/Thu/Fri. Main org line 844-464-2735; HQ 306 Malcolm X Blvd.

name: Housing Works Cylar House (Keith D. Cylar Community Health Center)
description: East Village health center at 9th St & Ave D with 24/7 syringe exchange, primary care and on-site drug checking.
notes: Syringe exchange 24/7 per outreach worker feedback (Oct 2026). NYC drug checking on Tuesdays (646-773-3678). Clinic services keep daytime hours.

name: Positive Health Project (Housing Works) – Ginny Shubert Center for Harm Reduction
description: Midtown harm reduction program on W 37th St with 24/7 syringe exchange, overdose prevention, HIV/HCV testing, counseling and meth harm reduction (ReCharge).
notes: Syringe exchange 24/7 per outreach worker feedback (Oct 2026). Counseling and testing keep daytime hours; call to confirm.

name: Bellevue Hospital – Street Health Outreach
description: Hospital-run mobile van offering syringe services and health outreach on the Lower East Side.
address: Delancey Street by Chrystie & Forsyth Streets, New York, NY
notes: Only confirmed via NYS SSP directory (Mon-Fri 9am-5pm); no dedicated program webpage found.

name: EXPONENTS – Syringe Services Van
description: Recovery and HIV services org that runs a syringe services van in Bedford-Stuyvesant.
notes: NYS: Bed-Stuy van Mon 5-10pm, Tue & Thu 12-5pm. Org HQ: 17 Battery Place, 8th Fl, New York, NY 10004.

name: OnPoint NYC – East Harlem
description: Overdose prevention center and drop-in offering supervised consumption, syringes, drug checking, meals, showers, clinical care and case management.
notes: One of two sanctioned OPCs in the US/NYC. Hours vary by source (NYC DOHMH, NYS, and OnPoint site differ); confirm before printing. Drug checking Tuesdays.

name: OnPoint NYC – Washington Heights
description: Overdose prevention center and drop-in in Washington Heights with supervised consumption, drug checking, meals, showers and clinical care.
notes: Formerly Washington Heights CORNER Project, which merged with NY Harm Reduction Educators in 2022 to form OnPoint NYC (onpointnyc.org/history). 2022 NYC guide phone 212-923-7600 is outdated. Drug checking Fridays.

name: Never Use Alone
description: Free, confidential peer-run hotline you can call while using; if you stop responding, EMS is sent to your location.
notes: Alternate number 877-696-1996.

name: NYC Health Map – Free Naloxone Finder
description: Search by ZIP code for free naloxone at pharmacies, community programs, and 24/7 public health vending machines.
notes: Can also call 311 to find naloxone.

name: NYC Health Department Free Online Overdose Prevention Training
description: Free virtual naloxone trainings from the NYC Health Department; participants can get a naloxone kit mailed to them.
notes: Contact: naloxone@health.nyc.gov

name: NYS Naloxone Co-payment Assistance Program (N-CAP)
description: Covers up to $40 of naloxone co-pays at participating pharmacies for people with prescription coverage.
notes: Confirmed via NYC DOHMH naloxone page; NYS N-CAP page URL returned 404 in this session.

name: Harm Reduction Delivered (NYS OASAS)
description: Free naloxone, fentanyl test strips and xylazine test strips mailed discreetly to any New York State address.
notes: Phone 765-MATTERS is for test strip orders. Delivery ~2 weeks.

name: NYC Health Department Drug Checking Program
description: Free drug checking: bring a small sample to a trained technician (or use a drop box) and get results plus harm reduction info.
notes: Sites: OnPoint East Harlem (Tue), Housing Works Cylar House (Tue), VOCAL-NY (Wed), Harlem United Bronx van (1st & 3rd Thu), BOOM!Health (1st Thu), OnPoint Washington Heights (Fri). Phones by site: 929-697-1132, 646-773-3678, 646-499-0542.

name: NEXT Distro
description: Online and mail-based harm reduction service providing naloxone and supplies plus education for people who use drugs.
notes: Has a New York page (nextdistro.org/newyork) but its scope was unclear; for NYC residents NYS Harm Reduction Delivered is the primary mail option.

name: DanceSafe
description: Nightlife harm reduction nonprofit selling reagent drug checking kits and fentanyl/xylazine test strips, with event services.
notes: Kits are sold, not free. No dedicated NYC chapter page confirmed.

name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
description: Free 24/7 call, text or chat line for mental health, substance use, or suicidal crisis.

name: NYC 988 (formerly NYC Well)
description: NYC's mental health and substance use support line, now reached by calling or texting 988 or chatting online.
notes: NYC Well rebranded as NYC 988; the old NYC Well number was kept only one year for transition. Direct counseling in English, Spanish, Mandarin, Cantonese; interpreters for 200+ languages.

name: NYS OASAS HOPEline
description: Free, confidential 24/7 line for substance use and gambling support and treatment referrals.
notes: Text HOPENY to 467369. Staff speak English, Spanish, Bengali, Chinese, Haitian Creole, Korean, Russian.

name: Trans Lifeline
description: Peer support hotline staffed by trans and nonbinary operators; does not call emergency services without consent.
notes: Not 24/7: Mon-Fri 1pm-9pm Eastern.

name: Crisis Text Line
description: Text with a trained crisis counselor any time.
notes: Text HOME to 741741 (HOLA for Spanish). Also WhatsApp.

name: The Trevor Project

name: Safe Horizon Hotline
description: 24/7 hotline for survivors of domestic violence, sexual assault, and other crimes, with shelter help and translation.

Most stops are early morning (5 to 11 a.m.) and days differ by site; check the city page for the current schedule. Questions: harmreductionunit@health.nyc.gov.
